title: RawManifest
description: Phase-2 strict full manifest. Author-facing source of truth.

capabilities.description:
Host capabilities this connector declares. Required and must be
non-empty (validated in [`crate::ParsedManifest::from_raw`]); a
missing or unknown entry fails strict parsing.

icon.description: Icon path relative to the manifest directory.

permissions.description:
Sandbox grants. Absent or `"unrestricted"` runs the connector with
the user's full privileges; an object (even `{}`) runs it in the
sandbox with exactly the listed grants. May be omitted, but not set
to `null`.

sync_version.description:
Format version of the sync results (`state`, document ids, document
content). Bump it when a new release cannot reuse what an older
release synced; Gety then resyncs on upgrade. Defaults to 1.

PermissionOs.description: Operating systems a `read` entry can be scoped to.

RawCapability.description:
Author-facing host capability declaration.

A capability is a **host-level feature/admission switch**, not a Deno
sandbox permission: it tells Gety which host integration points a
connector participates in. A manifest must declare at least one.

Today only [`RawCapability::DataSource`] exists — a connector that polls
and indexes documents. Future host capabilities (e.g. preview,
notification) will extend this enum; unknown values fail strict manifest
parsing (serde rejects unknown variants).

oneOf.description: Connector polls a source and indexes documents (`data-source`).

default_value.description:
Author-supplied default. JSON is loose here on purpose; consumers
coerce to the right [`crate::FormFieldValueType`] and reject
mismatches at validation time.

options.description:
Required when `field_type` is `Dropdown`. Ordering is preserved
(Vec, not Map) so dropdowns render in the order authors specify.

RawConfigFieldRef.description: A grant whose value comes from the user's configuration.

field.description:
Name of the field on the host's `Doc` (core field or metadata
key) whose value is the link target. Resolution semantics
(no dot-path) live on the host side.

oneOf.description:
Aliases mirror the prior Python-connector behavior that called
`kind.to_lowercase() == "url"`, so existing third-party
`connector_meta.yaml` files using `URL` / `Url` keep parsing.
Aliases never round-trip through serialization (canonical form
is the lowercase variant).

RawFieldType.description:
Author-facing field-type names. Maps to [`crate::FormFieldType`] in
the runtime crate's manifest parser.

RawIndexingStrategy.description:
Manifest-side mirror of `gety_core::indexing_strategy::IndexingStrategyType`.

Lives here (not in `gety-core`) so runtime crates can declare
manifest schemas without pulling in the heavy host. The host owns the
`From<RawIndexingStrategy>` bridge into its concrete enum.

oneOf.description: Run with the user's full privileges (`--allow-all`).

RawPermissionSet.description:
Sandbox grants. Every list defaults to empty.

`default` is listed after `skip_serializing_if` in each field's serde
attribute so specta renders the field as optional (`net?:`) in `types.ts`.

env.description: Environment variable names the connector may read.

net.description:
Hosts the connector may connect to: `"*"`, `host`, `host:port`,
`*.domain`, IPv4 or `[IPv6]` literals, or a `text` config field.

read.description:
Paths under `~` the connector may read, optionally per OS, or a
`directory` config field.

run.description: Program names the connector may run. Equivalent to full privileges.

RawPermissions.description:
Manifest `permissions`: the string `"unrestricted"` for full privileges,
or an object (possibly `{}`) listing sandbox grants.

interval.description:
Legacy shorthand for an interval (seconds). Prefer `interval_seconds`.
Clamped to ≥ [`MIN_SCHEDULE_INTERVAL_SECONDS`]; sub-minimum values set
[`crate::ParsedSchedule`]'s `interval_was_clamped` so the host can warn.

strategy.description: Update strategy. Absent means legacy interval shorthand.

time.description:
Daily poll time `HH:mm` or `HH:mm:ss`, local time (used with
`strategy: "daily"`).

RawScheduleStrategy.description:
Author-facing update-schedule strategy. Host-neutral: parsed into
[`crate::ParsedSchedule`], which `gety-core` maps to its runtime config.

oneOf.description: No automatic polling; the host triggers updates explicitly.
Poll once per day at `time` (`HH:mm` or `HH:mm:ss`, local time).

RawSchema.description:
Manifest `schema` block — declares extra indexed fields beyond the
built-in (title / content / metadata) defaults.

Deno-local copy of the shared schema contract: it reuses
[`gety_connector_meta::RawIndexedField`] but renames the author-facing
field to `extra_gety_indexed_fields`, keeping the Python-shared
[`gety_connector_meta::RawSchema`] (`extra_indexed_fields`) untouched.

RawScopedRead.description: A `read` path that only applies on the listed operating systems.
